headline: EOS Drops 11% in Broader Cryptocurrency Selloff
summary: EOS tumbled 11% during a sharp market rout, extending recent declines among alternative cryptocurrencies.
why: EOS is an open-source blockchain platform designed for decentralized applications; its native token is traded across major cryptocurrency exchanges.

impacts.name: EOS
impacts.why: The cryptocurrency fell 11% in an intraday rout.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: EOS declined by 11% amid a wider selloff across digital asset markets.
